propositions: A single criterion's evidence run budget exhaustion currently aborts the entire bounded recovery and discards all previously gathered evidence, failing the gate with 'bounded evidence recovery also failed'
The per-criterion evidence loop treats budget exhaustion of one criterion as fatal to the aggregate recovery, when budget is a per-criterion safeguard that should not doom the whole process

Recovery must catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, and token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError, substitute content-free placeholder evidence entries, and continue processing remaining criteria
Placeholder evidence entries must mark the criterion as exhausted and unverifiable-within-bounds so the finalizer cannot render them as affirmative verdicts
Recovery fails only when every criterion's evidence run fails; partial evidence from successful runs plus exhausted placeholders must reach the finalizer for structured verdict generation
Successful recovery behavior (where no evidence agents fail) must remain byte-identical to the current implementation
